acceptance.gate: Phase 3 gate G3 per master-plan v2.1 §9: reproduce the qualitative result — refinement concentrated at the hole resolves the stress gradient with far-field staying coarse (DOF savings vs uniform). No scalar acceptance value; this is a workflow/capability demonstration, not a numerical verification with limits.
acceptance.record: Level-2 elements resolve the stress gradient at the hole edge; von Mises near hole on locally refined mesh; meshing log reports per-level refined cell counts.

base_model: E01 in full (same part, dependent instance Plate-1, same mesh and job); complete the E01 example first

geometry.note: Identical to e01.json; authoritative dims live in e01.json. No separate CAD file for this example.

materials.note: Identical to e01.json Steel; authoritative record is e01.json.

mesh_refinement.balancing: refinementBalance = two_to_one (face-adjacent levels differ by at most one); additional cells refined to enforce it
mesh_refinement.level_note: level=2 refines two levels deep; each level halves the element size, so in-plane size at the hole edge goes from the background size to background/4
mesh_refinement.offset: default (offset=0.1 shown as example value in one snippet; WITHOUT explicit offsets each refinement takes its own level default — level-1 and level-2 defaults taper the band toward the surface). Exact default-offset formula: unknown, see note.
mesh_refinement.offset_note: Doc states the default offset equals mesh-degree times element size at the refinement's level (narrowest band in which every refined-level basis function touching the surface can activate, since each function spans degree+1 cells per axis). The largest per-axis element size is used. Record the exact numeric default used in the worked example as unknown pending the scripting section re-read.

region.assembly_set: hole (inner cylindrical face of the hole)
region.selection_bbox: x in [-1.1, 1.1], y in [-1.1, 1.1], z in [-1.0, 1.0] (hole r=1; plate outer faces at x=±5, y=±2.5)
region.set_location: on the ASSEMBLY (part-level sets are prefixed with instance name and will NOT match sets=['hole'])

mesh_refinement.also_documented: multi-level tapering (one refinement per level with own offset), level escalation to 3 via mesh.setRefinementValues, SphereRegion/BoxRegion geometric alternatives
